title: The World Wears White
next_chapter_hook: "Just as various forces believed the world had been settled, a blurry figure quietly appeared in the dense forest outside the Tianqing Sect— that was Chen Ji's new identity, and the crisis he sensed was approaching in an unprecedented way."

text.content: "The Tianqing Sect Council Hall was decorated with lanterns and red silk hanging high. If one hadn't witnessed it personally, no one would dare believe— the grand council chamber of one of the three great sects was celebrating so lavishly over the 'news of death' of a servant disciple. Sandalwood smoke curled gracefully, melodious music played, the sect elders wore appropriate smiles, but each harbored ulterior motives in their hearts. The inventory of Chen Ji's 'posthumous' belongings was being flipped through rapidly, each page connected to considerable profits."

dialogue.content: "Ha! Ha哈哈哈哈！" Han Lie laughed long and loud toward the sky, slapping the armrest with one palm. The armrest, forged from refined gold, actually cracked from the force. "He's dead! Thattrash finally died! You Tianqing Sect juniors can rest easy now, from now on no one dares speak defiantly before our Xuanwu Sect!"

text.content: "However, before Han Lie's words had even finished, a confidant leaned in to whisper in his ear. His expression instantly became extremely interesting— from ecstasy to astonishment, then to disbelief, finally freezing on a suffocating pig liver color. It turned out that over ninety percent of the wealth Chen Ji had registered 'during his lifetime' had already been transferred to an unknown hidden vault, while the remaining ten percent were all worthless junk that no one wanted."

dialogue.content: "What did you say?" Han Lie grabbed his confidant by the collar and lifted the entire person up. "All transferred? Where did thattrash get these things from! Investigate! Investigate thoroughly for me! I want to see who's backing him behind the scenes!"

text.content: "Meanwhile, in a hidden cave dwelling at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Su Qingyao was sitting across from a shadowy phantom. The teacup between them still retained warmth, tea fragrance interweaving with faint demonic energy, creating an oddly harmonious sensation. Su Qingyao held a transmission talisman in her hand, the corners of her lips slightly raised, that smile carrying three parts sarcasm, three parts helplessness, and four parts 'I knew it all along' understanding."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing gently set down the teacup. That bewitching face rarely showed a genuine smile: 'Senior Fellow Su, this 'trash' of your Tianqing Sect is even more troublesome than the most cunning strategist in our Holy Sect. The prophecy he gave...' She paused, a trace of lingering fear flickering in her eyes. 'I still can't believe it was true.'"

"Su Qingyao snorted lightly, tucking the transmission talisman into her sleeve: 'His schemes go far beyond these.' Her gaze turned to the void outside the cave dwelling, as if she could penetrate layers of mountain stone and see a certain figure secretly smiling in the shadows. 'But if he truly dares to get himself killed, I'll be the first to never forgive him.' The tone was cold, yet carried a hint of worry that even she hadn't noticed."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji observed all this from the shadows. Facing Han Lie's rage and the private exchanges between his two romantic interests, how should he conclude this 'feigned death' drama?"

choices.description: "Have Mo Xiansheng spread more false information, causing Han Lie to make even more foolish moves in his rage, further depleting the Xuanwu Sect's prestige."
choices.visible_reward: "Han Lie continues to make a fool of himself, Xuanwu Sect loses face completely"
choices.risk_hint: "Actions too large may alert other forces"

text.content: "Several days later, news spread under the push of those with ulterior motives: Chen Ji had left a testament letter 'during his lifetime,' naming a certain 'treasure' to be given to Han Lie. For a time, the entire cultivation world waited to watch the joke on the Xuanwu Sect's first genius— that so-called 'treasure' was nothing more than a broken bowl engraved with the word 'idiot.'"

choices.description: "Know when to stop, let various forces deplete themselves in chaos while secretly observing who the real mastermind is."
choices.visible_cost: "Give up the opportunity to expand the results"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve strength, observe enemy and ally situations more clearly"
choices.risk_hint: "May cause enemies to mistakenly think you're truly weak and can be bullied"

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his consciousness, quietly closing the Tianji Record's sensing function. Each additional use of the foresight ability brought him one step closer to that 'deadly backlash.' Current restraint is for a more ruthless settlement in the future. He had all the patience in the world."

"On the imperial court's side, a secret letter was delivered at the fastest speed to the depths of the palace. The letter contained only a few words: 'Tianqing's Chen Ji is dead, the three-sect structure will change, please Your Majesty decide.' In the imperial study, a pair of long, pale hands gently tapped the desk. After a long moment, a low laugh sounded: 'Interesting... dead? Hmph, I want to see what tricks this chess game can still produce.'"

dialogue.content: "Deep within the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, Ling Yuan sat枯坐 on a meditation cushion, his spiritual pressure profound as the abyss. A black-robed figure silently appeared behind him, kneeling to report: 'Reporting to the Sect Master, the disciple has confirmed Chen Ji's death; his remains were taken by the Demonic Path Saint.' Ling Yuan slowly opened his eyes. In those turbid old eyes, a meaningful gleam flickered: 'Dead... is that so?'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan waved away the black-robed figure. In his withered palm, an ancient jade slip materialized. That was the secret treasure passed down through generations of Tianqing Sect masters— the 'Mirror of Origins,' which could trace the气息 traces left by anyone within three days. He stared at the blurry light shadows in the mirror, his brow gradually furrowing: 'The aura of the Heavenly Fate Key... so he is indeed connected to that matter.' The old sect master's lips curved into a cold, sinister smile."

dialogue.content: "On the first page of the Tianji Record, the elderly phantom formed from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was stroking his beard with a smile. Chen Ji's spiritual projection stood at his side, only hearing Mo Xiansheng say slowly: 'Young master's 'feigned death' move has indeed tested out the various forces quite thoroughly. Han Lie has courage but no strategy, nothing to fear there; the imperial court is watching and waiting, still undecided. But that old sect master...' He meaningfully paused. 'Even more troublesome than this old one anticipated.'"

choice.prompt: "Mo Xiansheng mentioned that Ling Yuan is more troublesome than anticipated, and Chen Ji must decide the next investigation direction."

choices.text: "Investigate the connection between Ling Yuan and Chen Nian's disappearance"
choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng mentioned that the year of Chen Nian's disappearance highly coincides with when Ling Yuan took over as sect master, hinting at a definite connection between them."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires consuming 5 Heavenly Fate points for deep foresight"
choices.visible_reward: "May obtain clues about Chen Nian's whereabouts"
choices.risk_hint: "Deep foresight will increase backlash risk and may be noticed by Ling Yuan"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before finally speaking: 'The year Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect was precisely one year before Ling Yuan took over as sect master. And when this old one traced that historical period, I discovered... an extremely hidden force was secretly pushing all this forward.' His phantom slightly trembled. 'Young master, some truths may be far more cruel than you imagine.'"

choices.text: "Temporarily set aside, focus on current schemes"
choices.description: "The clues about Chen Nian are too distant; currently prioritizing consolidating feigned death results and accumulating strength."
choices.visible_cost: "Miss the best timing to investigate Chen Nian"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Heavenly Fate points, maintaining trump cards for larger schemes later"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan may complete some dangerous plan during this time"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the surging emotions. 'Mo Xiansheng,' his voice wascalm得近乎ruthless, 'Chen Nian's matter, I've noted it. But not now.' He turned to gaze at the void beyond the Tianji Record, flames burning in his eyes. 'Wait until I've killed all those who deserve killing, then I'll go find her.'"

"Meanwhile, inside the Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie was throwing a tantrum over that 'testament letter' and the broken bowl. He crushed the transmission talisman to pieces, roaring: 'Chen Ji! Even if you're dead, I'll scatter your ashes to the wind!' Yet he didn't know that in some dark corner, a pair of eyes was recording all his embarrassing display— that was Ye Qing's planted spy."

dialogue.content: "When Ye Qing's transmission finished describing Han Lie's狼狈模样, Chen Ji couldn't help but laugh lightly. 'One broken bowl in exchange for the Xuanwu Sect's first genius losing composure,' he blinked at Mo Xiansheng. 'Sir, this deal, worthwhile.' Mo Xiansheng shook his head with a helpless smile, yet couldn't hide the admiration in his eyes."

text.content: "After the laughter, Chen Ji sobered his expression, his gaze penetrating the barrier of the Tianji Record toward the distant horizon. There, a patch of barely visible dark clouds was slowly gathering— that was a sign of spiritual energy anomaly, meaning the seal of a certain forbidden grounds was loosening. His eyes darkened slightly: 'Han Lie and his kind are merely skin diseases. The real trouble... is coming.'"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice came悠悠, carrying a hint of solemnity: 'Young master is correct as anticipated. Forbidden grounds anomaly, imperial court secret agents, Demonic Path stirring... there must be connections among these three.' He looked meaningfully at Chen Ji. 'This old one ventures to guess— young master's 'feigned death' scheme may have touched a net far larger than imagined.'"

choice.prompt: "Facing the approaching crisis and Mo Xiansheng's warning, Chen Ji must make a choice: take the initiative with a new identity, or continue to lie in wait?"

choices.text: "Take the initiative, create a new identity"
choices.description: "Use the chaos of the forbidden grounds opening, disguise as a figure from some new faction, stir up trouble under the noses of all parties."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires completely hiding original aura, unable to use some abilities of the Tianji Record in the short term"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain a brand new identity as cover, can leisurely scheme in the shadows without being suspected"
choices.risk_hint: "Once the new identity is exposed, will fall into extremely dangerous circumstances"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng clapped his hands in praise: 'Excellent plan! Appearing as a forbidden grounds survivor is the most covert approach.' He took out an ancient mask from his sleeve. 'This object is called 'Thousand Illusion Face,' left behind by former master Chen Xuan. It can perfectly alter the wearer's aura and appearance. Young master, use it to create a whole new world.'"

choices.description: "Continue existing in the shadows, let all parties exhaust themselves fighting over the forbidden grounds first, then reap the渔翁之利."
choices.visible_cost: "May miss certain opportunities within the forbidden grounds"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve strength, see clearly the true stance of all parties before deciding"
choices.risk_hint: "Forbidden grounds opportunities may be seized by others first"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze profound as an abyss. 'Let them fight first.' His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable certainty. 'I only need to appear at the final moment and take what I want.' At this moment, the shadow of that 'trash' completely dissipated, replaced by a cold and precise chess player."

"As night fell, Tianqing Sect's celebration banquet finally entered its concluding phase. Guests departed one after another, leaving only杯盘狼藉 and a mess behind. Han Lie left resentfully under the escort of Xuanwu Sect disciples, not forgetting to glare viciously at Tianqing Sect's mountain gate before leaving. That gaze was filled with almost tangible resentment. And Ling Yuan, alone in the depths of the forbidden grounds, was playing with the Mirror of Origins. Reflected in the mirror was a meaningful smile."

"When deep night fell and silence reigned, an almost imperceptible aura quietly left the Tianqing Sect's borders. That was Chen Ji's true body. Using the Tianji Record's concealment function and the Demonic Path mist gifted by Ye Qing, he turned into a wisp of blue smoke, drifting toward the direction of the forbidden grounds. New identity, new schemes, new chess game— and he had already entered the game. On the distant horizon, those dark clouds grew ever thicker. A storm sweeping across the world was brewing."
